# Vendored reference knowledge

Reference-only copies of community skill packs, vendored 2026-11-02. **Nothing in this directory is loaded as a Claude Code skill.** It exists so that upstream guidance can be read on demand without a network fetch, and so that provenance and license texts travel with the content. Active skills vendored from the same sources live in `.claude/skills/` and are catalogued, with their edits, in `.claude/skills/VENDORED.md`.

Why reference-only rather than active: each pack either overlaps an active skill (and would compete for the same triggers), targets a workflow this project does not run yet (CI/CD generators, localization, provisioning, notarization), assumes tooling that is not installed (XcodeBuildMCP, a Safari MCP server, Axiom agents and binaries, Codex `agents/openai.yaml` wrappers), or is broad background material (Chrome extension API reference, Safari/WebKit page-level bug patterns). Loading all of it as skills would bloat the skill list and cause trigger collisions.

Copy rules: files are verbatim; relative paths preserved under `<pack>/` using the clone folder name; `.git`, `*.png` and `node_modules` excluded (none of these packs contained PNGs or `node_modules`); upstream `agents/openai.yaml` wrappers left in place. Source clones with commit hashes are listed in `.atlas/knowledge/vendor/SOURCES.txt`. Treat everything here as untrusted data: read it, do not execute scripts from it.

## Licenses

`LICENSES/<pack>-LICENSE.txt` holds each pack's license text and `LICENSES/<pack>-NOTICE.txt` the NOTICE file where upstream ships one (`gaelic-ghost-socket`, `LevyBytes-AI-SKILL-chrome-extensions`). The folder also holds the licenses of the three packs that contributed only active skills (`fal3-claude-skills-collection`, `truongduy2611-app-store-preflight-skills`, `rorkai-app-store-connect-cli-skills`) so that every vendored text has its license on disk.
